subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should the repository accept these 14 upstream GitHub Action revisions for privileged token, release, security-scanning, and Codex-agent workflows after reviewing their release/security impact?
rationale: The diff intentionally changes third-party code executed with secrets and publishing permissions; this is an ownership and supply-chain acceptance decision, not a mechanical correction that can be inferred from the patch alone.

options.title: Review and accept pinned upgrades
options.body: Confirm the relevant upstream release changes and merge only after the refreshed final-head workflow runs pass.

options.title: Split sensitive action upgrades
options.body: Land ordinary setup/labeling action bumps separately and defer token, release, attestation, CodeQL, and Codex-action revisions for focused owner review.

options.title: Pause the batch
options.body: Close or defer this dependency batch if the workflow owners do not want to accept the upstream behavior changes now.

recommendation.title: Review and accept pinned upgrades
recommendation.body: Confirm the relevant upstream release changes and merge only after the refreshed final-head workflow runs pass.

likelyOwner.reason: No individual owner was established from the supplied history context; the responsible workflow/security owner is the required decision-maker.
